lessons.title: Your first Rust program.
lessons.explain: Cargo builds and runs projects. Variables are immutable by default, which prevents a whole class of bugs.
lessons.exercise: Run cargo new hello, then print two variables, one of them mutable.

lessons.title: Who owns a value, and when it dies.
lessons.explain: Each value has one owner. Assigning it elsewhere moves it, and borrowing with & lets others read without taking it.
lessons.exercise: Write a function taking &String that returns its length, then use the string afterwards.

lessons.title: Group data and add methods.
lessons.explain: A struct groups fields and impl blocks attach methods. &self borrows the instance instead of consuming it.
lessons.exercise: Add a method that returns the distance from the origin.

lessons.title: Match on every possible case.
lessons.explain: An enum is one of several variants and match forces you to handle every one. The compiler checks that you did.
lessons.exercise: Add a Mul variant and fix the compile error it causes.

capstone: A fast file search tool that prints matching lines with line numbers.
